description: This Java source file defines a Spring component class DelinquencyActionParseAndValidator that extends ParseAndValidator. It provides methods for validating and parsing delinquency action commands related to loan delinquency management, including handling 'pause' and 'resume' actions with specific validation rules. It also includes helper methods for extracting and validating JSON parameters, checking overlapping periods, and ensuring loan states are appropriate for actions.

classes.name: DelinquencyActionParseAndValidator
classes.description: A Spring component class responsible for parsing and validating delinquency actions such as pause and resume on loans, ensuring correct date ranges, loan state, and non-overlapping periods.

methods.name: validateAndParseUpdate
methods.description: Validates and parses a delinquency action command, applying business rules based on the action type ('pause' or 'resume'), and returns the parsed delinequency action.

methods.name: parseCommand
methods.description: Parses the JSON command into a LoanDelinquencyAction object, extracting action type, start date, and end date.

methods.name: extractAction
methods.description: Extracts and validates the action type ('pause' or 'resume') from the JSON input.

methods.name: extractStartDate
methods.description: Extracts the start date of the delinquency action from JSON.

methods.name: extractEndDate
methods.description: Extracts the end date of the delinquency action from JSON.

methods.name: validateBothStartAndEndDatesAreProvided
methods.description: Ensures both start and end dates are provided for pause actions.

methods.name: validatePauseStartAndEndDate
methods.description: Ensures that pause start and end dates are not the same, enforcing at least a one-day pause period.

methods.name: validatePauseStartDateNotBeforeDisbursementDate
methods.description: Checks that the pause start date is not before the loan disbursement date.

methods.name: validateLoanIsActive
methods.description: Verifies the loan status is active before performing actions.

methods.name: validatePauseShallNotOverlap
methods.description: Ensures that a pause period does not overlap with existing pause periods.

methods.name: isOverlapping
methods.description: Determines whether two delinquency periods overlap based on start and end dates.

methods.name: validateResumeStartDate
methods.description: Validates that the resume start date is the current business date.

methods.name: validateResumeNoEndDate
methods.description: Ensures that resume actions do not specify an end date.

methods.name: validateResumeDoesNotExist
methods.description: Checks that no existing resume action already exists for the specified start date.

methods.name: validateResumeShouldBeOnActivePause
methods.description: Ensures that the resume action occurs during an active pause.

methods.name: raiseValidationError
methods.description: Raises a validation exception with a globalized error message, optionally associated with a specific field.
